snippet.title: Halls of Torment - The Boglands - Now Available!
snippet.description:
Halls of Torment - The Boglands
Featuring two new characters, an entirely new map with a dozen Items, three new Abilities and a dozen new challenges.

Available now on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series!
